name: site-nav
title: Site nav
description: A site header that works with no JavaScript: the page links sit in a native details, a Menu button on narrow screens and a row on wide ones, with the current page in aria-current. No dialog or drawer. Quiet is plain links over a hairline rule; warm writes them in the hand with a pencil line under the current page; playful makes them stamped tabs.
